caption: The drawing depicts a single object composed of several distinct parts, primarily shaded in grayscale tones. At the top, there is a cylindrical cup or holder, with shaded texture suggesting metallic material, and appears to be partially filled with a solid substance. This cup is supported by a U-shaped frame that connects it to a central vertical rod. The rod is straight and connects downward to a wide, flat, circular base which provides stability. Attached to the vertical rod and base by loops is a chain, which is depicted hanging loosely and partially lying on the base, with a hook or key-like item attached to the end of the chain and extending outward onto the surface. The entire composition is centered on an otherwise blank, light-colored background, with fine details emphasizing texture and form.
title: Pennsylvania Fat Lamp
